newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Namibia follows S.Africa with 0.25 point rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Namibia follows S.Africa with 0.25 point rate hike.

text.p: Namibia's central bank, the Bank of Namibia, has followed the lead of South Africa's Reserve Bank by increasing its lending rate to commercial banks by 0.25 percentage point to 17.75 percent.

A Bank official said on Tuesday Namibia had been obliged to review its interest rates given its close economic and monetary ties with South Africa. The Namibian dollar is pegged one-for-one against the South African rand.
South Africa's central bank announced a one point hike in its key Bank rate to 17 percent effective last Thursday.
Namibia's commercial banks are currently deliberating whether to pass the rate increase on to borrowers.
